name: eng
mood: Engineering Studio: a focused, bright Scandinavian-industrial studio. Pale birch wood, slate-blue carpet, matte black steel, warm task lighting, tidy cable management, a few green plants. Calm and competent with small nerdy touches.

items.prompt: A birch standing desk two tiles long on black steel legs with two slim monitors showing colorful lines of code (no readable text), a mechanical keyboard, a mouse, a ceramic mug and a tiny succulent. The monitor screens face along the red arrow.
The SAME birch standing desk seen from behind: the matte black backs of the two monitors with neat cables, black steel legs.
An ergonomic office chair: black mesh back, a charcoal seat cushion, armrests, a gas lift and a five-star base with small wheels.
The SAME ergonomic office chair seen from directly behind: the back of the black mesh backrest nearest to us, hiding most of the seat, the five-star base with wheels.
A retired build server rack nicknamed the Toaster: a black steel cabinet with a glass door, rows of servers with tiny green and amber status lights, a hand-painted toaster sticker on the side.
A small round birch side table on three black legs with a stack of paperback books and a mug.
A tall open birch bookshelf with black steel frame: rows of colorful programming books, binders, a small plant, a rubber duck and a retro robot toy. Its open front faces along the red arrow.
The SAME tall birch-and-black-steel bookshelf seen from behind: its plain birch back panel and black steel frame.
A matching tall birch-and-black-steel bookshelf holding stacked zines, board games, a cactus, labelled storage boxes and a small trophy. Its open front faces along the red arrow.
A slouchy round beanbag chair in burnt-orange corduroy with a soft dent in the middle.
The same slouchy round beanbag chair in plum-purple corduroy.
The same slouchy round beanbag chair in electric-cyan vinyl with a glossy highlight.
A slouchy round beanbag chair in hot-pink vinyl with a glossy highlight.
A tall birch-and-black-steel bookshelf seen from behind: plain birch back panel and black steel frame.
A black steel server rack seen from behind: a vented back door with bundles of neatly tied blue and yellow cables and a few green status lights.

A wide whiteboard, about 2.6 : 1, in a slim aluminium frame with a marker tray: a hand-drawn architecture diagram of boxes and arrows in blue, red and green marker, a few yellow sticky notes (no readable text).
A felt pennant flag hanging vertically (point down), tall and narrow, in amber-orange with a cream trim and a simple gear icon.
A felt pennant flag hanging vertically (point down), tall and narrow, in cobalt blue with a cream trim and a simple phone icon.
